hook: 3 signs your clip is too long

items.title: Setup over 3 seconds
items.say: One. The setup takes more than three seconds.

items.title: A second point starts
items.say: Two. A second point starts. Cut it there.

items.title: You would skip it
items.say: Three. You would skip it yourself. Be honest.

caption: Be honest, is yours too long? ✂️ Save this before your next cut.
